post.description: Start only an approved configured workload; sandbox must be running. Atomically claim one active run per sandbox. Durable idempotency and execution_ref allow recovery after unknown HTTP outcome. No shell is built from caller input. Unsupported artifact transfer gives 422 before execution.

post.description: Durably fence execution_ref under the same sandbox serialization lock as execute. If no run exists, return run_id:null,status:fenced and reject future new execute for this reference with 409 execution_cancelled. If a run exists, return its ID/status and reconcile cancellation; completed terminal runs remain terminal. Repeated fences are idempotent. Never create a workload while cancelling an ambiguous execute request.

get.description: Liveness checks only process. Readiness includes service-owned database, worker/runtime availability; unavailable real runtime never passes. No credentials or internal addresses returned.

BearerAuth.description: Server-configured opaque service/client token; TLS or private trusted transport is required.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Opaque trace ID; generated if absent. Echoed on every response. Rejected if malformed.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Durable deduplication scoped to effective owner + operation + target. Same canonical JSON replays current resource; changed JSON gives 409.

OwnerId.name: X-Owner-ID
OwnerId.description: Only credentials explicitly configured as delegates may set this header; other credentials receive 403 when supplying it. Delegates must supply an owner from their configured allowlist. Effective owner is never inferred from body metadata.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque exclusive cursor. Stable durable ordering; repeat retrieval is supported.

detail.description: Only allowlisted operational data: safe error code, attempt number, exit code, duration, identifiers. No arguments, output, credentials or sensitive payload.

arguments.description: Validated against the configured workload JSON Schema; canonical encoded arguments are limited to 16384 bytes. No command, shell, image or mount fields are accepted unless part of an approved workload schema.
